messages.subject: devtools::check() abort warning when compiling with TMBad framework
messages.subject_clean: devtools::check() abort warning when compiling with TMBad framework
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I get an abort warning from devtools::check() similar to that reported in issue # 233 <https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/issues/233> when I include a Makevars.win file in the src directory of my TMB R package (github.com/Andrea-Havron/clustTMB <https://github.com/Andrea-Havron/clustTMB>). I include the Makevars file in order to specify the new -DTMBAD_FRAMEWORK flag. I have read the section in TMB's Distributing code guide <https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/wiki/Development#distributing-code> about this issue but haven't had success resolving the error. The devtools::check() passes without warning when I do not include the Makevars file in src but then the model does not compile with the TMBad framework.

The initial compile has the following flags:

"C:/rtools40/mingw64/bin/"g++ -std=gnu++11  -I"C:/Users/ANDREA~1.HAV/DOCUME~1/R/R-41~1.3/include" -DNDEBUG  -I'C:/Users/Andrea.Havron/Documents/R/R-4.1.3/library/TMB/include' -I'C:/Users/Andrea.Havron/Documents/R/R-4.1.3/library/RcppEigen/include'     -DTMBAD_FRAMEWORK   -O2 -Wall  -mfpmath=sse -msse2 -mstackrealign  -c clustTMB.cpp -o clustTMB.o

The compilation without TMBad has the following flags:
"C:/rtools40/mingw64/bin/"g++ -std=gnu++11  -I"C:/Users/ANDREA~1.HAV/DOCUME~1/R/R-41~1.3/include" -DNDEBUG  -I'C:/Users/Andrea.Havron/Documents/R/R-4.1.3/library/TMB/include' -I'C:/Users/Andrea.Havron/Documents/R/R-4.1.3/library/RcppEigen/include'        -O2 -Wall  -mfpmath=sse -msse2 -mstackrealign  -c clustTMB.cpp -o clustTMB.o

The abort warning reports:
 File 'clustTMB/libs/i386/clustTMB.dll':
    Found 'abort', possibly from 'abort' (C), 'runtime' (Fortran)
      Object: 'clustTMB.o'
  File 'clustTMB/libs/x64/clustTMB.dll':
    Found 'abort', possibly from 'abort' (C), 'runtime' (Fortran)
      Object: 'clustTMB.o'

The Makevars.win file:
PKG_CXXFLAGS = -DTMBAD_FRAMEWORK

Specs:
Windows 10
R 4.1.3
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
g++ 8.3.0
TMB 1.8.1

Thanks for any suggestions!
Andrea
